archive_key_note: debian-ports rotates its archive signing key, so a snapshot older than the keyring shipped in the resolver image fails signature verification rather than expiry. A timestamp is pinned together with the keyring vintage that can verify it.
comment: One archive state and one base image identify a build. The resolver that schedules the build, the guest APT configuration, the source downloads, and the package builder all read this file, because a timestamp recorded in one of them and not the others reproduces nothing. builder_base.sha256 is measured from the image file wherever it is present and carried as a recorded value where it is not, because the image is local state the repository excludes; builder_base.status_sha256 and builder_base.build_closure_report_sha256 bind the base's exported package state and the closure seeded with it, which is the transaction the batch planner sizes from.
